answer: Trust propagation from a seeded core resists sybils: weight flows outward from a small trusted kernel along attestation edges, decaying each hop like ripples from a jetty. An identity reached only by a long thin path earns little; a fake cluster grafted onto the outer garden inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL to it through honest vouchers who stake their own standing. Minting fakes with no real inbound edges from the core buys no influence.
